turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian. Melissa Goh here. Thanks for setting aside time for our telephone appointment. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would another moment be better?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Melissa. Now is good. I'm in my office with the door closed. I prefer these telephone appointments; easier than arranging a trip down between meetings. I've got my handwritten notes beside me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's convenient. We can keep our conversation focused, so you have time before your next meeting. First, for the usual identity checks, please tell me your FIN and date of birth.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Sure, let me put my notebook down for a moment. [[EV_010]] [[EV_011]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. Let's move to our discussion. [[EV_001]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've reviewed the information you sent over. My notes are a bit untidy, so bear with me while I find the right page. I tend to write everything by hand during calls.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll leave a little space while you get your notes organised. We don't have to rush through the conversation just because it's a telephone appointment.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, I've found the page I was looking for. [[EV_012]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish, you mentioned preferring brief correspondence. For routine appointment messages, would you like us to keep the scheduling details together rather than spread them across separate emails?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, please. A short message with the main administrative points is easiest for me. My inbox gets quite crowded during the working day, and long email chains are difficult to keep track of.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that preference for routine correspondence. Required documents will still come through the usual channels. For future telephone appointments, we can arrange a suitable time ahead rather than call while you're in a meeting.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be helpful. I can set aside a quiet slot and have my notebook ready. Thanks for keeping the conversation straightforward today, Melissa.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome, Adrian. Thank you for your time. I'll let you get back to your day. Have a good afternoon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, you too. Goodbye.
